name: @vsor/sor-site-e2e
description: The browser tier of specs/sor-site/surface/spec.md (B5-B14). Assembles fixture sites from the vsor init scaffold + fixtures/tiny, builds them stock and themed, serves them statically, and runs the Playwright acceptance. Driver: run.sh (invoked by `make surface`). Deliberately has no `test` script: the suite only makes sense against the servers run.sh starts.
